_about: Tekken 8 stage_id -> stage name, spelled exactly as in the stage tracker (index.html). Source: ewgf.gg's current stage enum, provided by the main developer via Mike on 2026-10-09 (ewgf plans to add stage names to the API itself). Tracker spellings used for 600 (dev: 'Pacman Map') and 1300 (dev: 'Celebration On The Seine'). Note 200/201: Urban Square Evening is 200 and plain Urban Square is 201 - the reverse of ewgf's older archived code.
